title: 2026-2027 NRF Foundation Ray Greenly Scholarship
text:
# 2026-2027 NRF Foundation Ray Greenly Scholarship

#### Description

The NRF Foundation Ray Greenly Scholarship Fund offers the opportunity for technology and supply chain students to attend the 2027 NRF NXT (formerly called NRF Foundation Student Program) in New York City, free of charge. Retail companies, including some of the most exciting brands in the country, are driving big tech innovation. 

 

The NRF Foundation Student Program introduces exciting career paths that might not have been considered, with sessions highlighting the impact tech, supply chain, fulfillment, and data and analytics jobs have on retail businesses.

 

Undergraduate college students pursuing a technology major (computer science, engineering, data science, etc.) or a supply chain major, you could be eligible to receive FREE travel and hotel accommodations to attend the annual NRF Foundation Student Program in New York City.

 

By attending this conference, you will have the opportunity to meet with dozens of retail recruiters hiring for technology and supply chain roles, hear from top leaders and executives in the industry, and explore the most exciting store locations in NYC.

#### Qualifications

• Undergraduate-level sophomore, junior or senior

• Currently pursuing a technology or supply chain major

• Enrolled full-time at an accredited college or university in the United States

• Minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale

• At least one job or internship related to your field of study or area(s)

## Industry Activities

 The IEEE Robotics & Automation Society works with industry and government entities through the IEEE RAS Industrial Activities Board (IAB). The IAB is responsible for all industry or entrepreneurial related matters, including the growth of the industrial community within RAS. 

The IEEE Robotics and Automation Society (RAS) wants to encourage students to play an active role in existing robotics standardization efforts. IEEE-RAS has a number of approved and active standardization efforts, which you can read about here, and we have set aside funds to provide travel support to students interested in attending the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026), which will be held in Pittsburgh, USA from 27 September – 1 October, 2026. IROS 2026 will feature numerous IEEE robotics standardization meetings.

We expect to award 3 travel grants to cover flights and hotel reservations within the IEEE guidelines and not to exceed $2,500 each. Conference registration will be covered as well through issuance of a complimentary registration code. This award is for undergraduate students, and priority will be given to students that would not have otherwise attended IROS (e.g., do not have a paper accepted). title: ATC 2026: The 2026 ACM SIGOPS Annual Technical Conference

ATC 2026: The 2026 ACM SIGOPS Annual Technical Conference

# ATC 2026

## ATC 2026 Student Scholarships and Travel Grants

ATC 2026 offers a limited number of grants to help full-time undergraduate and graduate students attend the conference in Hong Kong. Students may apply whether or not they are presenting work.

Funding is competitive and may cover conference registration and part of reasonable travel and accommodation expenses. Awards may not cover all requested costs.

### Eligibility

Applicants must:

- be enrolled full-time at an accredited institution;
- study computer science, computer engineering, or a related field;
- attend ATC 2026 in person if selected; and
- disclose all confirmed or pending funding for the trip.

Postdoctoral researchers are also eligible.

### Application Materials

Please submit:

- the completed application form;
- a CV of no more than two pages;
- proof of current full-time student status.

Applications will be evaluated based on financial need, relevance to ATC, expected benefit from attending, available institutional support, and contributions to broad participation.

### Important Dates
